question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who do you think Colt is making out with?
Did you have a good time at your Prom?

nodes.text: As fast as she can, $ZOE scrubs her arm...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, come on... There is no way I can go to Prom smelling like a garbage can full of dead skunks...
It seems helpless... The horrible odor just won't go away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! I know!
$ZOE reaches into the closet and grabs her expensive, high-end soap, the one her parents sent her from Italy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was saving this for a special occasion...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What could be more special than this?
$ZOE sprays the soap onto her hands! She scrubs and scrubs... And the smell starts to fade!
After a few minutes, it's gone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Huff... Huff... I can breathe again...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `That` was close...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was close...

nodes.text: Where Howard is waiting in a sharp-looking tux!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! You look beautiful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! You're looking quite dapper yourself...
$ZOE gives Howard a long, tender kiss. He carefully attaches a lovely corsage to her dress...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow, is that, uh, a new perfume?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Maybe...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's lovely... A little, er, strong... Kind of like nine perfumes mixed together...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that smell underneath it... What is that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE, I don't want to freak you out, but a raccoon may have died under your floorboards...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's just get to dinner, okay?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ready for dinner?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That depends... Are you ready for the best Prom ever?
For one second, a nervous look crosses Howard's face... And then vanishes into a smile!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure thing! Let's roll!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Shoot... I just can't remember the number...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is it this one?
Sam holds up a business card.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Right! Brendan gave it to me!
$ZOE dials the number on the card...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you think we should do? Call her and hang up? Ring her doorbell and run away?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, yeah... Why don't you leave the revenge plotting to me, cuz?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Was I being too mean?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sometimes, I honestly wonder if we're actually related.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What we need to do is some classic Old Testament revenge... Any bad thing she did to you, she gets hit with threefold!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You had to spray yourself with that nasty junk... So we'll make her drink it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But how?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: First, we'll get a bottle of water and peel off the labels...
Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then, she'll run into the bathroom to throw up... And `that's` when we release the bees!
nodes.text_bbcode: And then, she'll run into the bathroom to throw up... And [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] when we release the bees!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow! That'll really show her... Not to mention break at least five laws...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What can I say? Spend enough time with Colt, and you start to see laws as more of 'suggestions'...
Just then, the doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no! That's Howard!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got so distracted planning revenge, I totally forgot to do my makeup!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well it's too late now! Get down there!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gahhh!
$ZOE races down the stairs...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: As much as I want to cut off her stupid pigtails... We can't focus on that now.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, are you kidding? She tricked you into spraying yourself with raw sewage!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know, but right now is Prom Night. If I get distracted by revenge, I'm not going to be able to focus on having a great night with Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And besides... What better revenge is there than giving Howard the best Prom ever?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That... Makes a surprising amount of sense.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: While she's busy at home cooking up another stupid scheme... I'll be on the dance floor, holding him in my arms, looking up into his big, dreamy eyes...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you sold me like a sentence ago. No need for the gory details.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now let me help you with your makeup!
Twenty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do I look?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Amazing!
Just then, the doorbell rings!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That must be Howard! I'm so nervous!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Relax, crazy, you look great! Now get down there!
Sam shoves $ZOE towards the door! She takes a deep breath and walks downstairs...
Ring... Ring...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Emergency Prom Support Line! Make it fast, because I'm busy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Huh? Oh, hey $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow. In retrospect, the fact that you're running this is `completely` unsurprising.
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow. In retrospect, the fact that you're running this is [color=#3b78e2][i]completely[/i][/color] unsurprising.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway! I need some Prom advice!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, uh, make it snappy, would you? I'm kinda towards the middle of my `own` Prom preparations...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, uh, make it snappy, would you? I'm kinda towards the middle of my [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] Prom preparations...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Do you have any idea how hard it is to ice sculpt a unicorn?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ah, but enough about me! What do you need advice on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, it's a little weird. See, I'm getting ready for Prom, and I went to try on this perfume that Howard left for me... But it smelled absolutely awful!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Like it had gone bad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, like someone bottled an unspeakable horror from another dimension!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: 'Eau de Necromorph?'
$ZOE looks at the bottle.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! That's exactly it! How'd you know?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, it's this crazy thing they found scavenging this deep sea wreck... You can buy it as a prank. It's all over the Internet...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Such a weird coincidence, though...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about? What coincidence?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Well, just the other day, Astrid called me asking for the grossest perfume I could think of... And, you know, I told her all about it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Astrid! That stupid... Conniving...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hey, much fun as this is, I really need to go... If I don't hurry up, Gideon Saint Gallop over here is gonna melt!
$ZOE hangs up and turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was Astrid! She sent me the perfume! She's trying to sabotage my Prom so she can get with Howard!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! That's low, even for her!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We need to get revenge... Now! No one messes with my cousin!
Ring... Ring...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Pasty Pete's Pasta `Prom`enade, how can I help you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Pasty Pete's Pasta [i]Prom[/i]enade, how can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eesh... Wrong number... Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Emergency Prom Support Line... EPSL!
Zoe dials the correct number.
Ring... Ring...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: Welcome to Crazy Dex's Crazy Homework Helpline! What subject would you like the answers for?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Wrong number... But it's good to know this exists...
Ring... Ring...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: You've reached the ESLP... Centerscore's `English as a Second Language Program!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've reached the ESLP... Centerscore's [i]English as a Second Language Program![/i]

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: For Spanish, please press `uno.` For Chinese, please press `dos.`
nodes.text_bbcode: For Spanish, please press [i]uno.[/i] For Chinese, please press [i]dos.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Wrong number... Sorry.
$ZOE tries to wash the smell off her arm... But it's just too pungent!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Keep scrubbing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't! It's just... Too smelly... I can't focus...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why would anyone ever make a perfume that smells like that? Why would anyone make `anything` that smells like that?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why would anyone ever make a perfume that smells like that? Why would anyone make [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] that smells like that?

nodes.text: Nothing $ZOE does will help!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no... If Howard has the world's smelliest date, he'll just continue to believe he's cursed!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know! You need to mask the smell! Howard won't be able to smell it underneath a bunch of other perfumes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooo! Good thinking!
$ZOE frantically grabs every perfume she can find and sprays them all over herself! After an exhausting few minutes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There! That horrible reek is gone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Too bad you smell like a perfume rack...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Better than smelling like the bathroom floor of a fish trawler...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That way, he'll get over this ridiculous idea that he's cursed!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That does kind of raise the pressure, doesn't it?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Naw! I'm sure you'll do fine!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So long as the evening doesn't go horribly, catastrophically wrong!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why would you put it like that?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Just know, if anything `does` go wrong, you can always call the Emergency Prom Support Line!
nodes.text_bbcode: Just know, if anything [color=#e23b3b][i]does[/i][/color] go wrong, you can always call the Emergency Prom Support Line!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: The what?
Brendan hands $ZOE a business card with a phone number on it.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: If you need help, just dial `555-EPSL!` See you at Prom!
nodes.text_bbcode: If you need help, just dial [color=#e23b3b][i]555-EPSL![/i][/color] See you at Prom!

nodes.text: Brendan bounds off. $ZOE looks down at the card nervously.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's no way I'll need this... Right?
$ZOE puts the card in her pocket... When Howard comes up and wraps his arms around her waist!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, babe! How's it going?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm okay... Just getting excited for Prom!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you excited?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, yeah, sure, why wouldn't I be?
$ZOE closely scrutinizes Howard's face, looking for any trace of anxiety...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No reason.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm feeling great. I picked out an awesome tux... Brendan planned a really fun night... And Astrid hasn't bothered me in a few days!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really?
$ZOE glances across the cafeteria. Astrid sits with several cheerleaders. She looks up and waves politely.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've got to get to Chemistry... See you later!
Howard gives $ZOE a kiss and walks off. $ZOE watches him go...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He seems fine. I'm sure Brendan's just overreacting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope.
Soon enough, it's Saturday... Which means it's time for Prom!
$ZOE and Sam stand around in her bedroom, getting ready...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: { La la la... Doing my hair... Gonna go to Prom... Howard's gonna look cute... La la la... {

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're the worst, you know that? The absolute worst...
$ZOE finishes the final touches on her hair and turns to put on her makeup...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey... Who sent you the gift?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Huh?
Sam points across the room at a gift package, covered in cute, tiny hearts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I don't know...
$ZOE picks up the package and opens it. Inside is an expensive looking bottle of perfume.
On the side of the bottle is a little note. 'Hope you have a magical night! -H.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww! Howard sent me some perfume! He really is the best boyfriend ever!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh. I take it back. `Now` you're the worst.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh. I take it back. [color=#3b78e2][i]Now[/i][/color] you're the worst.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was going to use my own perfume, but... I'm sure this'll be nice!
$ZOE takes the bottle and sprays a little onto her arm...
And an unearthly stench fills the room! It reeks of rotting fish, sulfur, and sweaty armpits!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh dear god... What... What is `that?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh dear god... What... What is [color=#3b78e2][i]that?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I don't know! It's absolutely awful!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It smells like someone threw up a carton of rotten eggs!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no, oh no... I... I need to do something about this... Before Howard gets here!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, hurry! Wash it off!
$ZOE runs to her bathroom sink and starts frantically scrubbing her arm...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean, I know Howard pretty well, and he never mentioned any fear of Prom to me...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh really? You know him `so` well... You didn't even know about the Punch-on-Pants debacle!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh really? You know him [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] well... You didn't even know about the Punch-on-Pants debacle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I knew about it... I just, you know, thought it had to do with a distinctive set of jeans...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Look, I understand. Howard's really good at hiding his feelings. For the first two months you guys were dating, I could barely tell that he was still hung up on Linda...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But I've known him for two years now. We've been through a lot... The Prank Wars, Boot Camp, that time we performed at Hector's party...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You just have to trust me on this. Prom is an emotional minefield for that guy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, okay, I get it. I'll make sure the night goes well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll be honest, I'm a little surprised... Howard never mentioned this to me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But you are one of his best friends, and you have known him longer. If you say so, I trust you!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wow! Thanks for being so reasonable!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: This went way better than when I tried to tell Amanda about Hector's claustrophobia... She just didn't understand how anyone could be afraid of Santa!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So you're on track? You know what to do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep! I'll make sure the night goes well.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Yay!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yay![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Just then, Brendan awkwardly strolls over to their table.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ahem. $ZOE. Mind if have a quick word with you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure...
$ZOE and Brendan step aside.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's up?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: So, I don't know if we've ever really talked... I'm Brendan, one of Howard's best friends...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. I know. You went to that koala preserve with us.
One week ago...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, Brendan? Hector? Are you sure you guys should be opening that cage?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course! They're so cute and cuddly! What could possibly go wrong?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I thought we all agreed never to talk about that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway! What `did` you want to talk about, Brendan?
nodes.text_bbcode: Anyway! What [color=#3b78e2][i]did[/i][/color] you want to talk about, Brendan?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, I just wanted to chat about the Prom plans...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, Howard told me all about them. Dinner as a group at that new fusion place, Global Gourmet, then we all drive together in a limo? Thanks for setting it all up...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, you know, I am something of a Prom expert... Not to brag, but I have quite the special night planned for Dinah... We're going to start with a lovely walk by the park, and then...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that why you wanted to talk to me? To tell me about your plans with Dinah?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Oh, right, I just sort of get off topic when I think about that... See, last year, I threw her the most `incredible` night...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, right, I just sort of get off topic when I think about that... See, last year, I threw her the most [color=#e23b3b][i]incredible[/i][/color] night...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Brendan! Topic! Stay on it!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Right!` Howard! I just wanted to make sure you knew how important it is that tonight goes `perfectly` for him!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Right![/i][/color] Howard! I just wanted to make sure you knew how important it is that tonight goes [color=#e23b3b][i]perfectly[/i][/color] for him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Yeah, I think it'll go well...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It can't just go well, $ZOE! It needs to go `perfectly!` If it doesn't... Well, I'm just worried about Howard's mental well-being!
nodes.text_bbcode: It can't just go well, $ZOE! It needs to go [color=#e23b3b][i]perfectly![/i][/color] If it doesn't... Well, I'm just worried about Howard's mental well-being!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Don't you know? Howard is terrified of Proms!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait, since when?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, every year, Prom is a disaster for him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know that last year, Linda dumped him right before, and he ended up getting mud all over his tux...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yeah, and the year before, there was the incident with the overturned salsa bowl...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That happened to Howard?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: And then at his eighth grade Prom... The infamous Punch-on-Pants debacle...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I `wondered` why everyone wrote that in his yearbook...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]wondered[/i][/color] why everyone wrote that in his yearbook...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I'm telling you. He's convinced he's cursed!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: He might seem cool on the surface... But inside, he's a total powder keg!

options.label: I'm glad you told me this.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, you think you know me `so` well...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you think you know me [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Am I wrong? You don't want to go to Prom because you're afraid you'll see Colt there with Denni!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: For your information, that is totally wrong!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...It is?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, it is. Colt wouldn't be caught dead at a Prom. He always said that Proms were for total suckers!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean, could you picture him all dolled up in a tux? With the little bow-tie and everything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha! That's true! He'd look like a surly penguin!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Yo, Flippers! Wanna go jack that iceberg over there? I bet we could sell it for, like, fifteen mackerels!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee hee!
Zoe reaches across the table and takes Sam's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Please come to Prom? Pleeeeeeeeeease?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, fine, I'll go...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, you think you know me `so` well...
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, you think you know me [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] well...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Am I wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, I... I admit, I don't really want to go without a date...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But honestly, Colt would've never gone with me anyway. He always said that Proms were for total suckers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If we were still together, we probably would've spent the whole night hanging out somewhere else, talking about how lame all the people at Prom are...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And you would've been unhappy and secretly wishing you were there.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Yeah. Yeah, I would have.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there you go. Going to Prom is something you `couldn't` do with Colt... So why not take advantage of the fact that now you can?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there you go. Going to Prom is something you [color=#3b78e2][i]couldn't[/i][/color] do with Colt... So why not take advantage of the fact that now you can?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...When did you get so manipulative?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I learned from the best!
Zoe reaches across the table and takes Sam's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So you're coming?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I guess I am...

nodes.title: Broken Prom-ises, Part 1
nodes.subtitle: Will Prom be the perfect night... Or a perfect nightmare?

nodes.text: One Friday afternoon, Sam sits alone in the cafeteria... When $ZOE appears over her shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, cuz!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dah! Why are you so chipper?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just excited for tomorrow! I mean, my first Prom! I bet Howard looks so good in a tux! What am I going to do with my hair?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You've been drinking coffee again, haven't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just six cups! Have you thought about what you're going to wear?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know... Honestly, I'm still not sure if I'm going to go.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? But you told me you would...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, I know... But now that it's actually time... I don't know, I kind of don't feel like it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Sam, you `have` to go! I promise it'll be fun!
nodes.text_bbcode: Come on, Sam, you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to go! I promise it'll be fun!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's what you said about the trip to the Koala Preserve...
One week ago, at the Centerscore Koala Preserve... Sam and Zoe stand around screaming frantically while a pair of koalas savagely attacks Hector's head!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: They looked so cute... Why are they `so mean?!` Aggggggh!
nodes.text_bbcode: They looked so cute... Why are they [color=#e23b3b][i]so mean?![/i][/color] Aggggggh!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I thought we all agreed never to talk about that...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Look, $ZOE, I just don't think it would be the best idea for me to go to Prom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh. Ohhhhhhhh. `I` know what this is about!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh. Ohhhhhhhh. [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] know what this is about!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! You don't want to go because...

options.label: You don't want to run into Colt there.
You don't want to go without Colt.

nodes.text: $ZOE lifts the fork to her lips... And takes one tenuous gulp!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually pretty good!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Wait, what? I always hated it...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I mean... How delightful! You have discovered an international wonderstation!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Wow! $ZOE's so brave! I would never try the soap fish!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I think I'm a pretty brave dude, but I'm not going anywhere near that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What can I say? One of us has to be the risktaker!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But don't worry, Howard... I'll be sure to come riding up to your tower when a mean old dragon takes you away!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's my girl!
$ZOE takes another bite.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Astrid... You want some? It's delightful!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No, I'm fine, thanks. I've, eh, eaten more than my fill.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Your loss!
Astrid glares at you, her nostrils flaring...
Then she sighs deeply and looks away.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I... I suppose you're right. That's what drives me so crazy.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I look at him, and I want him so badly... And yet he will not so much as lay a kissing upon my cheek.
$ZOE reaches out and puts her hand on Astrid's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Honestly, Astrid, when you're not being a crazy, manipulative psycho, you seem like a pretty cool girl.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure there are `tons` of guys at Centerscore who'd like to date you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure there are [color=#3b78e2][i]tons[/i][/color] of guys at Centerscore who'd like to date you.

nodes.text: Astrid smiles and turns around.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: And you, $ZOE... You are not so bad yourself. You have a heart as kind and warm as a leathery grandmother's.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You know what's crazy? I was prepared to go all-out tonight. To really try to destroy you.
Astrid takes out a coffee from behind her back.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I was even going to pour this all over your dress!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where... Where were you keeping that?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, I have my ways...
Just then, the limo comes to a halt in the Centerscore High parking lot!
Astrid stumbles forward... Spilling her coffee all over $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My... My dress... You got coffee all over my dress!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Astrid, listen to me. I know you like Howard. And maybe, where you're from, acting like this is considered normal.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, not at all! I was voted 'Most Likely To Be A Crazy!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, that's... Actually oddly comforting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway. My point is... Whatever game you're playing... Whatever you're trying to accomplish... It's not going to work.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love Howard. And Howard loves me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Now you can flirt with him all you want... And you can do your best to try to sabotage our evening...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But all it will do is drive Howard further and further away from you. And on some level, you `must` understand that.
nodes.text_bbcode: But all it will do is drive Howard further and further away from you. And on some level, you [color=#3b78e2][i]must[/i][/color] understand that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, listen up, you perky, pig-tailed bimbo... You need to back off Howard if you know what's good for you.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This little game you're playing... The horrible perfume, the lutefisk, the constant flirting with Howard... It ends `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: This little game you're playing... The horrible perfume, the lutefisk, the constant flirting with Howard... It ends [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Or what, land whale? You'll break one of your fingernails trying to ball a fist?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, you think you're real bad, don't you?
$ZOE shoves Astrid! She lurches back!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: `GASP!` You dare lay hands on me?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]GASP![/i][/color] You dare lay hands on me?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I warn you, little cauliflower, that I am not a dainty daisy...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ooo, I'm shaking!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You listen here, Pippi Lamestocking. You're in America now. You're playing by `our` rules. And if you think you're the toughest girl at Centerscore High...
nodes.text_bbcode: You listen here, Pippi Lamestocking. You're in America now. You're playing by [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] rules. And if you think you're the toughest girl at Centerscore High...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Then you've never been on the bottom of a cheerleading pyramid.
Astrid leans forward, getting up in $ZOE's face!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, I see how it is! You are the silverback gorilla, pounding your hairy chest, and I, the spry chimpanzee, must scamper off. Is that it?
$ZOE angles up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, that's right! You better believe it! I'm `totally` a silverback gorilla! And you'd better believe that I've got a hairy... A hairy... A...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, that's right! You better believe it! I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]totally[/i][/color] a silverback gorilla! And you'd better believe that I've got a hairy... A hairy... A...

nodes.text: $ZOE sighs deeply.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Astrid... Look at us. What are we doing? Are we seriously about to fight?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I was prepared to tussle, yes.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And what the point of that be? Howard loves me. I love him. We're happy.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And nothing you did will sabotage that.
When there's a sudden commotion from the other side of the limo. $ZOE spins around...
And finds Astrid leaning over Howard, stroking her hand along his lapels...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What in the...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, Howard... You look so absolutely ravishing in your formality suit... Like a dashing, manly penguin!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, uh, listen, maybe you should talk to your `own` date...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, uh, listen, maybe you should talk to your [color=#e23b3b][i]own[/i][/color] date...

nodes.text: Astrid playfully tweaks Howard's bow-tie...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Tell me again, my dark prince. What do you call this little bon mot?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's a bow-tie...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Bow tie...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Like a `bow` and arrow, firing a shot straight into my chest, `tying` my heart into a knot!
nodes.text_bbcode: Like a [color=#3b78e2][i]bow[/i][/color] and arrow, firing a shot straight into my chest, [color=#3b78e2][i]tying[/i][/color] my heart into a knot!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just... I can't even begin to fathom how your mind works.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahem!
Howard and Astrid turn to look at you. Howard has a trapped, panicked expression!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That does it... If I don't deal with Astrid `now,` she's not going to stop until she's ruined the night!
nodes.text_bbcode: That does it... If I don't deal with Astrid [color=#3b78e2][i]now,[/i][/color] she's not going to stop until she's ruined the night!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey! Astrid! Want to join me up in the sunroof for a minute?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Well... It might be a tight fit for someone of your size... But I suppose we can just barely squeeze in!
$ZOE and Astrid stand up in the sunroof as the limo nears Centerscore High. The cold, night air whistles by them...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: What do you want, gravy boat?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hate to be the bearer of bad news, Dex... But Astrid doesn't really like you. She's just pretending to so she can get close to Howard!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh, yeah, I know that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... You do?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, totally! She told me all about it! She'd come along as my Prom Date so she'd get a chance to mess with Howard... Or, as she calls him, 'my dark Prince.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait a minute... So you knew all this time that Astrid didn't really like you... And you just went along with it?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well, yeah! Of course!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But... Why?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh, hello? I'm a 5 foot 3 inch nerd with a 4.9 GPA and a drawer full of asthma medication!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: When else am I going to get a chance to make out with a saucy, Norwegian goddess?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's a really sad world view, Dex.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well, how does it stack up against my original Prom plans...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sitting at home alone and trying to get the 'Played For 50 Hours Straight'  Achievement in `Ogres and Elves Online?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Sitting at home alone and trying to get the 'Played For 50 Hours Straight'  Achievement in [color=#e23b3b][i]Ogres and Elves Online?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's equally sad.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Game. Set. Match.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, that didn't work...
$ZOE tries to think of something else to say...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Uh, really? Because I'm pretty sure my type is `total hotties...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, really? Because I'm pretty sure my type is [color=#e23b3b][i]total hotties...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, Dex. You know what I mean.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're an intellectual... A thinker... A gentleman scholar.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Well... I do look quite dashing in a frock, if I may say so myself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Exactly! And you deserve a girl who suits you, a girl who likes math and robots and getting good grades!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have to admit, that doesn't `really` sound like Astrid, does it?
nodes.text_bbcode: You have to admit, that doesn't [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] sound like Astrid, does it?

nodes.text: $ZOE and Dex look up at Astrid. She's taken off her shoes and is hurling them out the sunroof!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Woohoo! Littering is the lightest of crimes!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I rest my case.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I... I'll admit, she's not exactly my dream girl... In fact, things started going downhill when she came by my house to ask me to Prom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: When I showed her my collection of vintage Japanese transforming robots, she screamed that she was bored and poured a cup of coffee on my mom.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yep, sounds like Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But on the other hand... It's not like I've got a busload of cheerleaders tearing down my door, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dex, if you don't like Astrid, you shouldn't pretend to just to have a Prom date. Plenty of cool people go to Prom without dates... Like my cousin, Sam! Or Brendan!
At the very back of the limo, Brendan and Sam shoot angry scowls at $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah... Sorry, $ZOE. I'm going to have to go with a bird in the hand is better than none... Even if that bird is crazy as a loon.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dex, please...
$ZOE tries to think of something else to say...
$ZOE tries to take a bite... And then shoves the plate away!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't... I just... I just can't.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just too gross!

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Miss, Global Gourmet is dedicated to celebrating the wonders of cross-cultural cuisine!

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: If you do not like the entree, that is your prerogative, but please abstain from such rude and insulting remarks!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh... Right... Sorry, sir.
The waiter storms off in a huff.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want to be rude, Howard, but... Do you mind if share your dinner?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure, I guess. It's just... If you didn't want to eat the lutefisk, why'd you order it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, because I... You know... I guess I wanted to try something new.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sounds like `someone` isn't very refined! Unlike my perky bombshell!
nodes.text_bbcode: Sounds like [color=#e23b3b][i]someone[/i][/color] isn't very refined! Unlike my perky bombshell!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh you petite, little flatterer! Tee hee!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm feeling like Indian food... I'll have the Chicken Tikka Masala.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Some Pad Thai please!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I guess I'll have a tempura roll.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Spaghetti and meatballs!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I'll have the...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE! You `must` try the lutefisk! It's a Norwegian specialty!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, $ZOE! You [color=#3b78e2][i]must[/i][/color] try the lutefisk! It's a Norwegian specialty!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure I know what I wanted to order...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, I see! You have a timid tongue, afraid of exotic delights! You are just like my great-aunt! So timid, yet so hefty!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, what's wrong, $ZOE? Don't like trying new things?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...I'll have the lutefisk, please.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE! You don't have to play her game!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know what I'm doing Sam. One lutefisk, please. Make it extra... Fisky.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Whatever pleases you, miss.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Eee! How delightful! This will be an adventure in cross-cultural mishaps!
The waiter takes the other orders and runs off. The group chats about good times...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So there we were, in the middle of the woods, hiding in a bush... And that's when we realized Officer Monte had a pet badger!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love this story...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I ate a badger once!
And then they chat about rough times...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: You know, I'll be honest, the last time we talked, she did seem upset... I don't know, maybe I haven't been paying enough attention to her lately...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Relax, Brendan! She loves you! She's just... You know... Going through a lot in college.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: So... Bored!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Agreed!
Fifteen minutes later... The food arrives! The waiter sets down everyone's meals in front of them...
And then puts a revolting, gelatinous blob in front of $ZOE! It has a pungent chemical smell!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What... What is `this?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What... What is [color=#3b78e2][i]this?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: It's lutefisk, miss. A traditional Norwegian dish.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but `what` is it?
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but [color=#3b78e2][i]what[/i][/color] is it?

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: A succulent Norwegian cod that's been steeped for days in a solution of lye!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Lye. Like... The chemical cleaner? The thing my mom uses to clean the drains?

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: That is correct!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And people eat this?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: In Norway, it is a delicacy! But if you do not want it, I understand. Your tastes are probably far too provincial...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no. I've got this.
$ZOE takes her fork and scoops up a big bite of lutefisk...
$ZOE grabs Howard and passionately kisses him!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Makeout party!
Amanda and Hector start making out too!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa, guys, maybe we should lay off the PDA...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Just come to Prom', she said. 'It'll be fun,' she said. If I'd known I'd be stuck here watching a bunch of couples make out...
$ZOE pulls away from Howard, the tips of their noses touching...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why'd you do that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because I have the best boyfriend ever!
$ZOE leans in for another kiss!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: `Enough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Enough![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone turns to stare at Astrid.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ahem. Perhaps we have had enough fun with the group kissings. Let us switch to lively conversation!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Yes, please...
Under the table, Howard squeezes $ZOE's hand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Love you too, babe.
Just then, a waiter walks up to the table.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Good evening! What can I get you tonight?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahem. Howard, aren't you so happy with our relationship that you don't feel the need to flaunt it in gross displays of affection?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Howard?
Howard, like everyone else, is transfixed by the increasingly implausible makeout happening between Astrid and Dex.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I've never seen anything like it...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: It's like a snake making out with an octopus...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But which is which...?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahem! Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Huh?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was just saying, aren't you so happy with our relationship that you...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh, okay, come on, that's just not human anymore!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ugh, just forget it!
Just then, a waiter walks up to the table and taps Astrid on the shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Excuse me, Miss? I'd like to ask you to stop doing... That. It's alarming our other customers.
Astrid pulls away from Dex!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, you Americans! So small-minded and Puritanical!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: My teeth hurt.

nodes.speaker: Waiter
nodes.text: Now, then. What can I get you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I am going to The Prom, of course! I am here with my date, Dex, the wise and shriveled owl!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's me!
Astrid throws her arms around Dex, planting a huge kiss on his cheek!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yowza!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But my sweet Dex, why are we sitting on the side of the table, like a pair of wheezy uncles? Let us sit towards the middle!
Astrid grabs Dex by the hand and slides over, shoving by Hector and Amanda... And sitting down right next to Howard!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Anything for you, my lusty Valkyrie!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You have got to be kidding me...
Howard leans down and squeezes $ZOE's hand. He whispers under his breath...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just stay cool... We can't let her get to us...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sure... I'll stay cool...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: So, uh, Astrid, do they have Proms in Norway?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, we have dances and festivals... But nothing with this pomp, this circumstance! It's so exciting! I love it!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I feel like a real `Prom`egranate!
nodes.text_bbcode: I feel like a real [color=#3b78e2][i]Prom[/i][/color]egranate!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's not a word...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, you are so smart, my dark doppelganger... The thoughts tumbling about in that thick, meaty head of yours...
Astrid leans forward, running her fingers through Howard's hair...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahem! Don't you have a date of your own?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Yes, I do! Dainty Dex, the wisest wizard in the land! I could eat his brain up!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Do they eat brains in Norway?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Come here, my studly muffin!
Astrid grabs Dex and begins passionately kissing him!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Holy... How is she bending her head like that? She's like some kind of crane...
You can see Howard twitching, vaguely uncomfortable...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's trying to make Howard jealous! Well, two can play that game...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: PFFFFFFFFFT!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ick!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE exploded!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Seriously declasse...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I... I just... What is `she` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, I... I just... What is [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.text: PFFFFFFFFFT!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ick!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE exploded!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Seriously declasse...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I... I just... What is `she` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, I... I just... What is [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.text: $ZOE swallows deeply, gulping down her water...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ahem. What, uh, what exactly are you doing here, Astrid?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: PFFFFFFFFFT!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Gah!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Ick!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: $ZOE exploded!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Seriously declasse...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I... I just... What is `she` doing here?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry, I... I just... What is [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] doing here?

nodes.text: And so, half an hour later, the whole group settles in for dinner at `Global Gourmet.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And so, half an hour later, the whole group settles in for dinner at [b]Global Gourmet.[/b]

nodes.text: $ZOE and Howard sit in the middle of the table...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Howard, this place is so fancy! And the menu is incredible!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know! I don't even recognize half these dishes!
On one side of them sit Hector and Amanda...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Did you like the sculpture I made?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It was nice... But you really didn't have to freeze a unicorn just for me.
A few feet away, Sam sits with a bored look on her face...
And just past her sits Dex, busy comforting a very nervous Brendan!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I just don't get it... Where's Dinah? Why isn't she returning my calls?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Relax, Brendan! I'm sure she's just running late! It's a long drive from Centerscore University...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I guess... But she's totally missing all the great stuff I had planned for her! The walk through the cemetery... The horror movie clip show...
Overhearing the conversation, $ZOE leans over and pats Brendan on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure it'll be fine, Brendan. So long as she's here for the dance, that's all that matters.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah, she'll probably get here any minute... Just like my date!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Wait, you have a date? Since when?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Since this afternoon, muchacho!
$ZOE takes a sip of her water...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: And look! There she is now!
The door to the restaurant swings open... And Astrid walks in!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Hello, my friends and neighbors!
$ZOE and Howard are going to have the perfect night... But you only played an `almost` perfect game!

$ZOE pulls herself down and sprints out of the limo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! $ZOE! Come back!
$ZOE rushes into the Prom, and Howard races after her. The rest of the group slowly files out after...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What's with them? Didn't they like the limo ride?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I don't know, Dex, that's not really the point! We're at Prom, and I still have no word from Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, would both of you pull your heads out of your butts?! I think something serious is happening with Howard and $ZOE!
Sam sprints after the two of them. She rushes into Prom...
And finds it packed! Most of the school is there, dancing away...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: $ZOE? Where are you? Are you...
Sam freezes. There, on the far side of the room, is Colt... Leaning over Denni!
A memory rushes back to Sam...
Six months ago. Sam walks out of Centerscore, Colt's arm wrapped around her shoulders...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please? `Please?` I've always wanted to go to Prom!
nodes.text_bbcode: Please? [color=#3b78e2][i]Please?[/i][/color] I've always wanted to go to Prom!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Then you're just going to have to go stag, babe! Prom is totally for suckers!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You won't catch me dead at a Prom!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, okay... Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm sure, babe. I promise.
Present day. Sam stares, stunned, at Colt and Denni.
Denni laughs at something Colt says, and he shrugs playfully.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...You jerk. You unbelievable jerk.
Sam turns and storms out.
Meanwhile, at the other end of the Prom... Howard finds $ZOE by the snack bar.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! $ZOE! What's going on? What's wrong? Why are you covered in coffee?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: On second thought, I'm pretty sure I know the answer to that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just... I wanted so badly for you to have a perfect night.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I appreciate that, but... Why the concern?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Brendan told me all about your issues with Prom, and how they always go wrong... And I just didn't want anything to ruin the night for you!
Howard laughs and steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE... Nothing could ruin the night for me. It's already perfect...
Howard wraps his hand around $ZOE's waist.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's perfect because I'm with you. And nothing Astrid does could `ever` ruin that.
nodes.text_bbcode: It's perfect because I'm with you. And nothing Astrid does could [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] ruin that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard...
A slow song gently washes over the two...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love this song...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Me too. Want to dance?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's nothing I'd like more.
$ZOE and Howard move to the dance floor. She puts her head on his shoulder. He holds her close. They sway gently to the music...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too, coffee cake.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just kidding!
Soon, the song is done.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to go freshen up real quick, okay? I'll be right back.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sure. I'll miss you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sure you will...
$ZOE gives Howard a quick peck and walks away...
She steps out into the dark hallway, en route to the girl's bathroom. $ZOE takes a few steps forward... And bumps into a couple making out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh! Excuse me!
The couple freezes and stares at her, shocked looks on their faces!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...Colt?!
Just who is Colt making out with? And what happened to Dinah?
Find out on next week's episode of Surviving High School! Or if you just can't wait, buy next week's Episode On Demand!

nodes.speaker: Denni
nodes.text: You ruined it!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I... I did not mean to!
The door of the limo opens. Howard steps out and looks up...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! What's going on? What happened to you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I... I can't take this! This night is horrible!
$ZOE pulls herself down and sprints out of the limo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! $ZOE! Come back!
$ZOE rushes into the Prom, and Howard races after her.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Geez! What's with them?
Inside the Prom, Zoe stands by the snack table. Howard walks up to her.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, what's... What's going on? Why'd you run out like that?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Do you really think this night is horrible? Is it something I did?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I swear, I was `not` flirting with Astrid...
nodes.text_bbcode: I swear, I was [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] flirting with Astrid...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, no. It's not anything you did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just... I really wanted this night to be perfect, really perfect...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And that stupid Astrid is ruining everything!
$ZOE slams her hand down on the snack table... And accidentally nails the edge of a nacho bowl!
It flips over, spraying hot nacho cheese all over Howard's face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Gahhhhh!` It burns! It burns with cheesy goodness!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Gahhhhh![/i][/color] It burns! It burns with cheesy goodness!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard, I'm so sorry, I...
Howard staggers back, hitting the edge of the table! The punch bowl flips over, spilling bright red punch all over Howard's lap!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No... `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No... [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A crowd has started to form... They're pointing and laughing...

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Ha ha! Hey look! Howard has punch on his pants!

nodes.speaker: Travis
nodes.text: Punch on pants! Punch on pants!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: This is going to be the biggest thing to hit the internet since Saxophone Cat!
The crowd breaks into a chant of 'punch on pants'! The room is lit up with the flicker of phone cameras going off!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It happened again! `IT HAPPENED AGAIN!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It happened again! [color=#e23b3b][i]IT HAPPENED AGAIN![/i][/color]

nodes.text: With a mournful wail, Howard sprints out of the room!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It... It wasn't Astrid. It was me! `I` ruined Prom!
nodes.text_bbcode: It... It wasn't Astrid. It was me! [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] ruined Prom!

nodes.text: Forcing Howard to relive his most painful trauma? `That's` no way to have a good Prom!
nodes.text_bbcode: Forcing Howard to relive his most painful trauma? [b]That's[/b] no way to have a good Prom!
